title: Structured Output for the Evaluation Bar
description: The evaluation call that demands a JSON number, plus the safe parser that returns a fallback instead of throwing.

steps.description: `getAIEvaluation` builds a prompt that asks for the evaluation from White's perspective as a single number, in pawns, and says to respond only with a JSON object like `{"eval": 0.5}`.
It calls `callTextModel` with `maxTokens: 120` and `temperature: 0`. The page says temperature 0 is part of asking precisely.
The comment says models often wrap JSON in fences or add stray words, so the code strips the fences, parses safely, and returns `parsed.eval` only when it is a number, falling back to 0.
`safeJsonParse` tries `JSON.parse` and returns the fallback on any error. The page says never trust the parse, so this returns a fallback instead of throwing.
